content.short: Zignaly is an AI-powered social trading platform and L1 blockchain (ZIGChain) focusing on global profit-sharing.
content.description: Zignaly is a pioneering decentralized investment platform and social trading ecosystem designed to democratize access to expert-led financial strategies. The platform features an AI-driven "copy trading" model where retail investors can follow the trades of top-tier professionals, paying only a share of the resulting profits. Zignaly recently launched ZIGChain, its own dedicated Layer 1 blockchain on Cosmos, to provide the essential infrastructure needed for scalable wealth-generation and transparent asset management. Powered by the $ZIG token, the protocol rewards users.
content.meta: Zignaly provides an AI-powered social trading marketplace and the ZIGChain network. Discover Zignaly and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Explorer.
